queue.subject: onsen.com scored 22/100 for AI shopping agents
queue.body:
Hi — quick note about onsen.com.

I run CartSignal, a public index that scores storefronts on how well autonomous shopping agents can read and buy from them. The agents in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini increasingly fetch a store on a customer's behalf before a human ever opens the page.

onsen.com scored 22/100. The largest gap: product markup — no crawlable product page found.

Concretely, that shows up as incomplete Product JSON-LD, so price and availability are unreadable.

The public breakdown is here: https://wyattpacker274-stack.github.io/cartsignal/sites/onsen-com.html

I built a specific fix pack for onsen.com: the exact llms.txt, the robots.txt lines, the JSON-LD block, and the order to apply them. It takes a template change, not a rebuild.

Want me to send it over?

— CartSignal
